_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Rush Around the Ruins#001.src: Ah, welcome to our town, soldier! I hope you don't mind the lack of facilities; we're not too well-off, as I'm sure you can tell.
Rush Around the Ruins#001.dst: ああ、兵士さん、この町へようこそ！設備が整っていないのはご容赦ください。お気づきの通り、ここはあまり裕福な町ではないのですから。
Rush Around the Ruins#001.speaker: Tempo Town Citizen

Rush Around the Ruins#002.src: Like most people, I moved here after my home was destroyed in the war. As much as I miss {p}, I've found ways to appreciate {p}, too.
Rush Around the Ruins#002.dst: 多くの人と同じように、私も戦争で家が破壊された後、ここに引っ越してきました。{p}が恋しい気持ちはありますが、{p}の良さも見つけることができました。
Rush Around the Ruins#002.speaker: Tempo Town Citizen

Rush Around the Ruins#003.src: I really like taking strolls around the ruins around here... It'll never beat the walks I used to take along the coastline, but it's still quite nice! From time to time, I even find treasure sitting around in the ruins, just there, untapped!
Rush Around the Ruins#003.dst: この辺りの遺跡をぶらぶら歩くのが本当に好きなんです……昔、海岸沿いを歩いていた頃には敵いませんが、それでもなかなかいいものです！ 時々、遺跡の中に、そのまま放置されたままの「お宝」を見つけることさえありますよ！
Rush Around the Ruins#003.speaker: Tempo Town Citizen

Rush Around the Ruins#004.src: Maybe you should try it out yourself? You might find some interesting stuff along the way, too! Talk to me again if you'd like to hear my route.
Rush Around the Ruins#004.dst: 一度、自分で試してみてはどうですか？その過程で、何か面白い発見があるかもしれませんよ！もし私のルートを知りたいなら、{c2}また声をかけて{/}くださいね。
Rush Around the Ruins#004.speaker: Tempo Town Citizen

Temple of Swords#001.src: How did you open this door? It's been sealed for as long as I remember.
Temple of Swords#001.dst: どうやってこのドアを開けたの？私が覚えている限り、ずっと封印されていたはずなのに。
Temple of Swords#001.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#002.src: However... This barrier doesn't look like it was made by the empire.
Temple of Swords#002.dst: しかし……この障壁は、帝国が作ったものには見えない。
Temple of Swords#002.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#003.src: It's still old, though. Let's give it a little nudge.
Temple of Swords#003.dst: とはいえ、やっぱり古いね。ちょっと手を加えてみよう。
Temple of Swords#003.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#004.src: Well, it seems to have fallen apart to the touch. This is one of the biggest rooms I've seen..
Temple of Swords#004.dst: うーん、触っただけで崩れ落ちてしまったようだ。ここは、私が今まで見た中で最も広い部屋の一つだ……
Temple of Swords#004.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#005.src: This must have been important... Let's go!
Temple of Swords#005.dst: これはきっと大事なところに違いない……さあ、行こう！
Temple of Swords#005.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#006.src: Don't you think this vault is a little grand for storing just gold?
Temple of Swords#006.dst: この金庫室、ただ金を保管するだけにしてはちょっと豪華すぎない？
Temple of Swords#006.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#007.src: Look, there's a pedestal for something here, like a weapon.
Temple of Swords#007.dst: ほら、ここに何か――武器みたいなものを置くための台があるよ。
Temple of Swords#007.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#008.src: The dust is disturbed around it. Someone has been here recently..
Temple of Swords#008.dst: 周囲のほこりが舞い上がっている。最近、誰かがここに来てたみたい……。
Temple of Swords#008.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#009.src: But why would they take whatever was here, but not all the gold?
Temple of Swords#009.dst: でも、どうしてここにあったものは何でも持ち去ったのに、金だけは全部持ち去らなかったんだろう？
Temple of Swords#009.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#010.src: Whatever was kept here, I think we can assume it was of great value to the Emperor.
Temple of Swords#010.dst: ここに何が保管されていたにせよ、それは皇帝にとって非常に貴重だったんだと思う。
Temple of Swords#010.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#011.src: We better get out of here, and don't even think about taking this gold - They are artifacts!
Temple of Swords#011.dst: さっさとここを離れたほうがいい。この金を持ち出すなんて、絶対に考えるな――これらは遺物なんだ！
Temple of Swords#011.speaker: Junes
